roadmap.title: Story with full synchronization
roadmap.description: Play Memories 1-9 and clear every optional objective as you go so His Full Attention finishes with the story. Free slaves during the missions, let a plantation bell ring for Silence, Fool!, and earn Firepower and His Own Medicine during the final memory.

roadmap.title: Naval side content
roadmap.description: With the Experto Crede unlocked, plunder ships for Thug Life, use the swing ropes for Roped In, finish a clean boarding for All Aboard!, harpoon the killer whale after liberating Tortuga, and swim for Mer-man.

roadmap.title: Cleanup
roadmap.description: Finish the remaining liberated slaves for Seeds of independence using plantations and slave ships.

steps.text: Free a slave during the campaign's opening sequence; any later liberation from a @loc{plantation}, @loc{slave ship}, or street event counts as well.

achievements.sortReason: Cumulative counter; finish the remainder in free roam after the story.
achievements.summary: Reach a running total of 500 freed slaves.

guide.context: The counter tracks freed slaves only; maroons are a separate resource and do not count.

steps.text: Free slaves as you play the story; the campaign itself requires 150 liberated slaves before Memory 5.
Clear @loc{plantations} for about 30 slaves each; they gain new owners over time, so the same plantation can be liberated again.
Sink a @loc{slave ship's} escort convoy without firing on the slave ship, then board it for about 90 slaves.

achievements.description: Kill 5 guards at once with a blunderbuss.
achievements.sortReason: Repeatable in Memory 4 or during Memory 9; also a Memory 9 optional objective.
achievements.summary: Kill five guards with a single blunderbuss blast.

guide.context: The @item{blunderbuss} is a single-shot, short-range weapon that can kill several enemies at once; you receive it after Memory 3.

steps.text: Replay the fourth memory, @loc{A Ship Of His Own}, through its opening @item{firecrackers} tutorial.
Stay on the rooftops, take out the guard on the left, and move to the position above the @item{powder keg}.
Throw firecrackers down so all five guards gather around the powder keg.
Fire the blunderbuss into the powder keg while the guards are grouped; if the group scatters, reload the checkpoint and try again.

achievements.description: Disarm the Gouverneur and kill him with the branding iron.
achievements.sortReason: Fixed part of the final memory; also a Memory 9 optional objective.
achievements.summary: Disarm the Gouverneur during the final mission and kill him with his branding iron.

guide.context: Do not tackle or kill the Gouverneur while he flees, and avoid hitting him with the blunderbuss, or the disarm becomes impossible. The branding-iron kill also satisfies a Memory 9 optional objective.

steps.text: Play Memory 9, @loc{de Fayet's Last Stand}, and chase the Gouverneur out of the mansion grounds.
At his destination, thin the guards with @item{smoke bombs} and other weapons, keeping the Gouverneur unharmed.
Equip the @item{fists} before fighting him, counter his attack, then press the disarm input to take his branding iron.
Attack him with the branding iron until he dies; the achievement unlocks with the kill.

achievements.sortReason: Unlocks automatically at the end of the final memory.
achievements.summary: Complete all nine story memories of Freedom Cry.

steps.text: Play all nine memories through to the end; the final memory's conclusion awards the achievement.

achievements.sortReason: Track every memory objective while playing the story; replay memories for anything missed.
achievements.summary: Complete every optional objective in all nine story memories for 100% synchronization.

guide.context: Only the optional objectives inside the nine story memories count; collectibles and side missions are not required. Memory 2 has none. If an objective fails, replay that memory later from the progress tracker; the achievement unlocks when the final memory ends with everything complete.

steps.text: Memory 1, @loc{The Calm Before The Storm}: locate the Templar Admiral's ship with the @item{spyglass}, then surprise the Templar fleet with a @item{mortar} shot.
Memory 3, @loc{Laying The First Brick}: push an overseer into the water and air-assassinate a guard from a height of at least 10 meters.
In the fourth memory, @loc{A Ship Of His Own}, call on @npc{Bastienne's girls} to distract the guards, then draw four guards together with @item{firecrackers}.
Memory 5, @loc{Lifting The Veil}: kill the overseer in charge of the slaves and free the slaves from the barracks.
Memory 6, @loc{A Scientific Inquiry}: complete all five investigations without killing anyone.
Memory 7, @loc{Plant The Seeds}: sink the pirate schooners before the brig and destroy the whole flotilla within six minutes.
Memory 8, @loc{Down With The Ship}: take less than 50% damage in the naval fight and rescue 15 slaves below deck without failing a quick-time event.
Memory 9, @loc{de Fayet's Last Stand}: take out five guards with the blunderbuss and finish de Fayet with the branding iron.

achievements.description: Kill a guard ringing a bell.
achievements.sortReason: Do it at any plantation during the story.
achievements.summary: Kill a guard while he is ringing an alarm bell.

guide.context: A guard only runs to the bell once he is alerted, and the kill still counts after the bell has started ringing.

steps.text: Travel to a @loc{plantation} and let the overseers spot you near the @item{alarm bell}.
Wait for a guard to reach the bell, let it ring at least once, then kill him before he leaves.

achievements.sortReason: Requires the Tortuga plantation to be liberated first, then a short sail west.
achievements.summary: Harpoon and kill a killer whale.

steps.text: Liberate the plantation at @loc{Tortuga} to make the killer whale icon appear west of the island.
Sail to the coordinates (336, 372) and watch for a light blue patch of water that marks the whale.
Approach the patch and hold the harpoon input to start the kill.
steps.note: Harpoons are limited, so aim each throw carefully.

achievements.sortReason: Cumulative; swim during free roam after the story.
achievements.summary: Swim a cumulative total of one nautical mile.

guide.context: One nautical mile is about 1.85 km, and the distance accumulates across the whole save.

steps.text: Swim in open water; for example, jump from any dock or from the deck of the @item{Experto Crede} and keep swimming. The achievement unlocks once the running total reaches one nautical mile.

achievements.sortReason: Repeat boardings during free roam; target small ships.
achievements.summary: Plunder a total of 30 enemy ships.

guide.context: A ship counts as plundered once its boarding objective is finished, such as killing the crew, detonating the powder stores, or pulling down the flag.

steps.text: Attack small enemy ships and thin the deck with @item{swivel guns} before boarding to speed each capture.
Board and complete the listed objective to register the plunder, then repair the ship or bribe the enemy before finding the next target.

achievements.description: Perform 5 air assassinations from a swinging rope.
achievements.sortReason: Spread across five boardings with the swing ropes.
achievements.summary: Kill five enemies with air assassinations launched from a swinging rope.

guide.context: The five kills can be spread across several boardings.

steps.text: During a boarding, walk to a @item{swinging rope} along the port or starboard edge of the @item{Experto Crede}; one hangs near the wheel at the stern.
Climb onto the ledge, crouch, and equip the @item{hidden blades}.
When the enemy ship is close, jump toward it and press attack on an enemy below to land the air assassination; repeat until five are done.

achievements.description: Board a ship without losing any crew members.
achievements.sortReason: Attempt during the same free-roam boardings as Roped In.
achievements.summary: Finish a ship boarding without losing any crew members.

steps.text: Free slaves beforehand to grow and equip your crew, then attack a small enemy ship and weaken its deck with @item{swivel guns}.
Board and eliminate the enemy crew with the @item{machete} before they can kill any of your crew.
Complete the boarding objectives; the achievement unlocks at the repair-or-bribe prompt if no crew member died.
